text: Chapter 13: The Water Tribe and Coenubia@The Great Battle Underwater
■Next Mission\nMove from Aquacity to\nCarretera Mar to start.
There are already a lot of Coenubias on the main road of\nCarretera Mar. It seems that they have occupied Marinatown.\nLet's hurry up and liberate it!
Everyone is running away from Coenubias when you enter\nMarinatown. They say some of them are being controlled by\nCoenubias. Proceed further to help them!
You saw some people who have really fallen under the\ninfluence of the Coenubias. Restore them and let's hurry to\nthe Council Branch Office!
Humida is waiting for you inside the Giant Plastida.\nIt seems to be the Coenubia that swallowed Venena before.\nLet's work together to defeat it!
The councilor who is taking Mera hostage in the Parliament\nHall has turned into Torexesa, a monster.\nDefeat him to free Marinatown from Coenubias!
